note: invariant -> seam -> planted defect -> named refusal -> test -> control. One row per planted defect (a refusal site that loops over several plants is one row naming each; a helper called once per plant is one row per call); 'site' is <module>.<function>#<ordinal of the refusal assertion in that function>, null with expected_error 'returned-refusal' when the seam returns its refusal instead of raising; 'marker' is refusal text an assertion pins, null where the test pins only the error class. Planted-defect proofs, not code-mutation testing. Enforced by tests/autobot/test_mutation_matrix.py.
